name: Kōtō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kōtō ward emblem in white: an outlined ring with eight small points enclosing the characters 江東.
history: Municipal flag of Kōtō, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 November 1951.

features.role: Kōtō ward emblem — an outlined ring with eight small points enclosing the characters 江東
